description: Seconds each suite takes, for run.mjs --shard (shard.mjs). Measured on 2026-11-19 from the conformance reports (each suite's start to end) of successful runs: go-binary x go (Go runs 44479785227, 44487957479, 44488679341, 44491349990), go-binary (Go runs 44487957479, 44488679341, 44491349990) and e2e (CI runs 44486951640, 44488679266, 44491350117). Each value is the largest of the three cells' medians, at least 1. Not run in those cells, so kept from the 2026-11-17 measurement: request-budget. Not in those runs yet, so measured locally on 2026-11-19 from conformance reports (go-binary x go 0.5 s, go-binary x source 4.8 s, ts-source x source 5.8 s): admin-cli. A suite missing here weighs shard.mjs DEFAULT_WEIGHT. Re-measure when a suite grows or shrinks by a minute.
